summary.en-US: Save Firefox bookmarks and open tabs to your Trilium inbox with one click.

description.en-US:
Web2Trilium shows all your Firefox bookmarks (organised by folder) and your open tabs in a sidebar or tab. For each entry you can:

* **Save to Inbox** — creates a Web View note in your Trilium inbox with the webViewSrc and url labels set, then removes the bookmark or closes the tab.
* **Delete / Close** — removes the bookmark or closes the tab without touching Trilium.

You can also reorganise your bookmarks by dragging them: drop a bookmark between two others to reorder it, or onto a folder to file it inside. Changes are written straight back to Firefox.

No background sync, no two-way logic — just a one-way manual action per bookmark or tab.

## Setup

1. In Trilium go to Options → ETAPI → Create new ETAPI token and copy it.
2. Right-click your Inbox note in Trilium → Copy note ID to clipboard (or use the Auto-detect button in Settings if your inbox carries the #inbox label).
3. Open Web2Trilium, click Settings, enter your Trilium server URL, ETAPI token, and Inbox note ID, then Save.

## Notes

* Only http:// and https:// tabs are shown — browser-internal pages are excluded.
* Saved notes work immediately with the webViewToolbarWidget.js Trilium widget.
* Empty bookmark folders stay in the list so you can drag bookmarks into them.
